d:
yeh lo dosto, exact 1000 din ke vanvaas ke baad hum sab laut aaye hai, i proudly present to you mere jigar ka tukda, humara pehla episode "Ekaki Chapter 1 : Presence". Aur yeh toh bas kahani ki shuruaat hai. hum intezaar nai kar sakte uss din ka jab aap chapter 2 dekhoge, tab aapko EKAKI ka asli matlab pata chalega
dedh saara pyaar do, like karo, and apna favourite scene batao kaunsa hai!
